CVS Health is hiring an Associate Software Development Engineer for its Provider Digital Experience business area. The role develops and supports enterprise web applications and APIs, contributes to AI and digital transformation initiatives, and helps implement testing, security, database, and Agile development practices.
Associate Software Development Engineer developing enterprise web applications and APIs, contributing to AI/GenAI initiatives, and implementing secure CI/CD and database integrations

Responsibilities:
• Develop and support enterprise web applications and APIs
• Contribute to AI/GenAI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
• Implement automated testing, CI/CD, and DevSecOps practices
• Perform application security remediation and code quality improvements
• Design and maintain database and data integration components
• Create technical documentation and participate in Agile development processes

Requirements:
• Work visa sponsorship is not available for this role. This includes participation in Curricular Practical Training (CPT), Optional Practical Training (OPT), and F-1 Visa programs
• Must have successfully completed corporate internship program
• Experience with machine learning, data pipelines, architecture, async APIs, AI agents, and modern web tools
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
